orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To construct a laddered bond portfolio over a 5-year horizon, we will allocate investments across bonds with maturities ranging from 1 to 5 years. This approach ensures a steady stream of cash flows and reduces interest rate risk by diversifying the maturity dates. Each year will have a similar allocation to maintain the laddered structure and comply with the maximum 30% allocation per year constraint. We will focus on investment-grade securities with a minimum credit rating of BBB+ to ensure creditworthiness and stability. The proposed allocation will keep the portfolio duration below the 7-year warning threshold, with a target duration of approximately 3 years to balance liquidity and yield.

This laddered bond portfolio ensures a steady stream of cash flows and reduces interest rate risk while maintaining a target duration of approximately 3 years.
